# IconButton

Square icon-only control with an accessible label and toggle support.

`Icyre.IconButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.IconButton icon={…} label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.IconButton" icon="{{…}}" label="…"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |

| `icon` * | `IconName` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `variant` | `'neutral' \| 'active' \| 'selected' \| 'destructive' \| 'play'` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  |
| `pressed` | `boolean` |  |
| `filled` | `boolean` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `forceState` | `'hover' \| 'pressed' \| 'focus'` |  |
